relationships.evidence: The project states that its harmonized food methods build on the European PEF framework.
relationships.constraints: Project beta rules may extend or deviate from generic PEF.
relationships.validation_question: Publish a clause-level profile and versioned deviations.

relationships.evidence: The project publishes a method for adapting national food LCA databases and cites AGRIBALYSE as a methodological foundation.
relationships.validation_question: Retain source-country data and explicit extrapolation parameters.

relationships.evidence: The two projects announced co-development of an LCI methodology intended as an umbrella PEFCR for food.
relationships.constraints: The joint method is still under development.
relationships.validation_question: Track the final jointly released document and governance.
